tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The ground. Warm uncoated stock in Paper, a microfilm reader in Reader. Every screen and every export sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Work cards, the evidence panel, the letter body. Separated from the page by a rule hairline, never by a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Statutory blocks, table zebra, citation-span containers. The field for anything quoted rather than asserted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and surface-raised. 15:1 in Paper, 16:1 in Reader.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Taglines, source names, secondary table columns. 6.4:1 on surface-page in Paper, 8.3:1 in Reader.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Capture dates, record ids, label text. 5.0:1 on surface-page in Paper, 5.1:1 in Reader. Do not go lighter.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline. Table rows, panel edges, section rules. Non-text only.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, input edges, the rule under a section label. Non-text; 3:1 against surface-page in both themes.

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The one brand accent. Oxidized vermilion, used like a date stamp: the mark, the active status, one primary action per screen. 6.4:1 in Paper, 5.5:1 in Reader.

tokens.name: stamp-muted
tokens.usage: Fills and blocks only, never text. The stamp at register weight for cover blocks and chip backgrounds.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: TERMINABLE·NOW, REVERTED·LIKELY, NEVER·GRANTED. Three actionable statuses share one colour; the word carries the distinction.

tokens.name: status-scheduled
tokens.usage: TERMINABLE·FUTURE. A date is known and has not arrived. Never animated, never a countdown.

tokens.name: status-clear
tokens.usage: PUBLIC·DOMAIN. No acquisition needed and no rights work at all.

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: EXCLUDED·WFH and LAPSED·WINDOW. Permanently closed on this channel; deliberately the same weight as ordinary metadata.

tokens.name: status-held
tokens.usage: GRANTED·ACTIVE. Held and exploited; monitor only.

tokens.name: evidence-span
tokens.usage: Background wash behind a verbatim citation span inside a quoted source. Background only, ink sits on top.

styles.name: deliverable-title
styles.usage: The title on a deliverable cover or a section front. One per document.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: The numbered section rule that runs through the CO·DISC pack. Set uppercase in CSS; the tracking is the whole effect.

styles.name: standing-rule
styles.usage: The closing pull quote on a deliverable. One per document, always the last thing on the page.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The opening paragraph under a section label, and the first line of a first-contact letter.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running prose, in documents and in the interface. Never set prose in sans.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Annotations, guideline notes, the explanatory line under a claim.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The research label on an export, figure notes, disclosure lines. Sets in ink-tertiary.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Field labels in the operator surface and the evidence packet. Uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Column heads on the queue and the evidence table. Uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: Table content that is not a computed value. Titles, party names, notes.

styles.name: ui-button
styles.usage: Controls. One stamp-coloured action per screen; everything else is a rule-strong outline.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The status enum from II. Always uppercase, always with the interpunct, never wrapped.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Statutory date math and claim-record blocks, on surface-sunken. Quoted, never asserted.

styles.name: datum
styles.usage: Any value the system computed or captured: dates, work ids, tiers, rule versions. The boundary between what Colophon asserts and what it quotes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tier badge and its date.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap inside a label-and-value pair.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding. The base pitch for cover geometry.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between evidence rows.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a claim and its evidence set.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing in a document. Also the largest a stamp field may ever be.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margin, gap between numbered sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default, everywhere. Documents of record have square corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The exception: inputs and the status chip, where a hairline square reads as a table cell.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reserved, and currently unused. The tier badge is square by design; if anything in this system ever becomes round it will be a person's photo in the outreach record, nothing else.
